wholePhysicalScope: Native OpenStreetMap way 94117018 fixes the original auditorium, faceted rear curve and attached northwest clock tower. The western entrance node supplies the central arch position.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the hall, three recessed Tudor entrances, 38-meter clock tower and open belfry. Closer levels refine clock hands, gates, arches, oculi and trim.
limitations: The auditorium uses the native footprint, mapped entrance and documented 38-meter tower. The hidden main roof profile, side openings, trim heights and crown dimensions are approximate.
The source elevation field is unchanged. Entry thresholds, stair geometry and foundation exposure are approximate.
The model is the permanent 2024 auditorium exterior. Interiors, adjacent high-rise, statue and separate grounds are outside scope.
